implementation: Two production instances of registered AST-AQU-006 bind to existing south_board and north_recovery source identities. No invented persistent save IDs or room/programme identities. Existing eight static rings remain unchanged.

Exact source collision proposals provide24 separate coaming wedges,96 thin seat patches and source grip capsule chains; open seating well and drain are preserved. Native asset and export are unchanged.
Original unoccupied buoyancy integrator and player scripts remain exact. Derived adapters add reference occupied mass, combined COM, displacement correction and an inertia-scaled game boarding hold.

RMB+E boards at a settled hold, then launches; E requests return to the same boarding point after a circuit, then leaves once settled. Space requests safe exit/return. Blocked exits retain rider and load.

Source entry ramps remain; existing supported bed stances provide safe exit. Clear berth offsets were surveyed against actual installed geometry. Ordinary approach is wading, not implemented swimming.
Verified directory travel releases occupant load/collision exceptions; destroyed occupants release load and request return. Broad AFK/pause/save lifecycle remains unfinished.

reference_load_model.implementation: Inherited original force integrator plus constant-displacement correction; real rigid-body mass and raised combined COM; no force-driven body pose/velocity resets after construction.

validation_note: After successful final physics runs, a prompt-only correction clears stale settling text once docked; GDScript parse checked. Physics and interaction transitions unchanged.
failed_attempts_retained: Original source water points intersect later entry geometry; clear offsets surveyed, no architecture removed.
South source bed stance was just beyond interaction range; ordinary short wading approach retained. Ramp-foot exit failed standing clearance and was not adopted.
Mass-scaled dock yaw damping became numerically unstable at capture. Replaced only added dock yaw term with effective-inertia scaling; both complete occupied circuits then pass. Failed logs retained.
holds: AFK/pause/save and durable float-instance identity lifecycle
species fit, load tuning and engineering acceptance
next_concrete_omission: Player swimming and water transitions beyond the shallow-river wading/state subset. Existing controller still delegates ordinary movement/gravity and supplies no swimming forces. Thermal visual water volumes are not promoted to gameplay volumes.
